# Welcome to the Agent Project

> A practical guide written by practitioners to help get your Agents running, scaling, and operating in production.

- [Welcome to the Agent Project](https://agentproject-ai.github.io/agentproject/readme.md): Welcome to the Agent Project
- [Exhaustive list of Agent Frameworks](https://agentproject-ai.github.io/agentproject/exhaustive-list-of-agent-frameworks.md): Description: Framework for orchestrating, optimizing, and automating LLM workflows with multi-agent systems.
- [1. Foundation of Agent Projects](https://agentproject-ai.github.io/agentproject/1-foundation-of-agent-projects/readme.md): Different Agent Workflow Patterns
- [Authors](https://agentproject-ai.github.io/agentproject/authors.md): This is written by a community of practitioners

## 1. Foundation of Agent Projects

- [The key functional areas of an AI agent](https://agentproject-ai.github.io/agentproject/1-foundation-of-agent-projects/the-key-functional-areas-of-an-ai-agent.md): Functional areas of an AI Agent

- [How to use Outcome, Role and Interaction (ORI) to design AI Agents for your organization](https://agentproject-ai.github.io/agentproject/1-foundation-of-agent-projects/how-to-use-outcome-role-and-interaction-ori-to-design-ai-agents-for-your-organization.md): In the rapidly evolving landscape of artificial intelligence, designing effective agent workflow systems requires a structured methodology that balances complexity with predictability.
